description: This source file contains implementations for trigger shape initialization functions for Mazda engines in a engine management system firmware. It defines various trigger shape configurations, including trigger event timings for different Mazda models and sensor setups, as well as functions to initialize and configure trigger shapes based on engine type.

methods.name: void initializeMazdaMiataNaShape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape for Mazda Miata NA engines with specific event timings and synchronization settings.

methods.name: void initialize_Mazda_Engine_z5_Shape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for Mazda engine with a particular event pattern based on the z5 sensor setup.

methods.name: void initializeMazdaMiataNb2Crank(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape configuration for Mazda Miata NB with crank sensor detection timings.

methods.description: Configures trigger shape with a specified offset for Mazda Miata NB engine, including primary and secondary sensor events.

methods.name: void initializeMazdaMiataNb1Shape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes Mazda Miata NB trigger shape with default offset.

methods.name: void initializeMazdaMiataVVtTestShape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape for testing VVT setup in Mazda Miata with specific timing offset.

methods.name: void configureMazdaProtegeSOHC(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for Mazda Protege SOHC model with a repeating pattern of sensor events and no synchronization needed.

methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for Mazda Protege LX model with multiple sensor event timings based on logs and timestamps, with no synchronization needed.
